defs.def: always behaving in the same way, or having the same opinions, standards, etc. 一致的；始终如一的

ex.t: 一成不变的习惯会导致压力。

ex.s: Now make comments on your partner’s story and see whether the language style is consistent.
ex.t: 现在对你同伴的故事进行评论，看看语言风格是否一致。

defs.def: happening in the same way and continuing for a period of time 连续的；持续的

ex.s: Remember, even world champion athletes practice their skills on a consistent basis.
ex.t: 记住，即使是世界冠军运动员也在持续练习他们的技能。

ex.s: Modem methods   63   tracking polar bear populations have been employed only since the mid-1980s,and are expensive   64   (perform) consistently over a large area.
ex.t: ___63___追踪北极熊种群的现代方法从20世纪80年代中期才开始使用，而且在大范围上持续___64___（perform）成本高昂。

ex.s: Indeed, it has been consistently ranked by the United 4o -Nations as one of the best countries to live in, and visitors are always:welcome!
ex.t: 事实上，它一直被联合国评为最适宜居住的国家之一，游客们总是受到欢迎！

ex.s: In addition, studies show that consistent eating habits, for example, taking three meals a day at the same time each day, are better for our health.
ex.t: 此外，研究表明，规律的饮食习惯，比如每天在同一时间吃三餐，对我们的健康更有益。

ex.s: In an interview she revealed that the secret of her consistent good performance was the training that she never missed.
ex.t: 在一次采访中，她透露自己持续优异表现的秘诀是从不间断的训练。

defs.def: in agreement with sth; not contradicting sth 与 … 一致的；相符的；符合的；不矛盾的
having different parts that all agree with each other 论点或一系列的观点

ex.s: I'm amazed that Calgary has been consistently recognized as one of the world's most liveable cities!
ex.t: 我很惊讶卡尔加里一直被认为是世界上最宜居的城市之一！

ex.s: People with more consistent stories tend to have a stronger sense of identity, and they feel their life has more meaning, direction and sense of purpose.
ex.t: 那些拥有更连贯人生故事的人往往有更强的身份认同感，并且觉得他们的生活更有意义、更有方向感和目标感。
